title: Underground Labyrinth
subtitle: Make the walls taller to guard more secrets. While people busy themselves with their affairs, the aroma of orange forces its way home.

items.text: Underground Labyrinth
A vortex, inside the bar, is whirling.
A vortex full of compressed lips, dull eyes, and irrational words.

items.speaker: Guest
items.text: I-I-I'm going home.
The speakeasy is shaking.

items.speaker: Guest
items.text: Let me outta here. I don't want any gathering! Screw the money! I'm leaving here ... lu-lunatics!

items.speaker: Guest
items.text: The walls are twisting.

items.speaker: Guest
items.text: The door ... where's the door? The window? Haha ... did I go crazy too?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: It's too dangerous outside.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Without our masks, you'll soon get infected with the "pernicious habit" of the era, and be sifted out by the "Storm."

items.speaker: Guest
items.text: I don't care! I don't give a f**k!

items.speaker: Guest
items.text: I can never repay the debt in my lifetime! Aha, let me go before I go insane ...

items.speaker: Guest
items.text: You are the government. I-I didn’t do anything wrong! I'm begging you, help us!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Don't be afraid. We will definitely ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: They've re-constructed the building. All the exits are blocked.

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: We got two civilians hurt already!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: There are so many masked civilians among our enemies ... The next battle will be harder!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We can't keep fighting like this. We need to find a way out ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Way out? Oh! Sotheby has got an idea!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Everyone, follow me! The exit is just behind the spotlight on the stage. Hurry up! Don't be left behind!

items.speaker: Bodyguards
items.text: We'll protect everyone on both sides! Hey! Stay close if you wanna live!

items.speaker: Guest
items.text: Me! Me! Me! Me!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The hidden path they just made? ... That may work.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Leave four behind for the team! Everyone else move! Don't get caught!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Members
items.text: Copy that!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Ha ha ha ha!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Why would they go underground? There isn't even a window.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: It gets easier. Think of the time. She'll be back soon.
Underground, The Walden

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hah?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Why is it ... quite different ... from before?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Was the wall in this color just now? I think ... there was a turn at the end ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Is it ... is it because of the great arcanum?!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: They've made an underground labyrinth in the speakeasy! The end of the labyrinth, what will that be?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, Sotheby and I have explored here for a while.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The overall area of this secret chamber is not too big, but many obstacles here can move. It's easy to get lost.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I had drawn a map before, and the exit is very close in this direction. As long as it's near the outer wall of the speakeasy, we will be able to break through!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Right! Right! Ms. Sonetto is exceptional!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ok. Then ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Yes. Follow the light.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Do not make any noise ... I will meet you soon.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: ... I'll go get Marian. I think I can find her. She must still be here!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Is Schneider casting an arcane skill ...?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: She is near us ... but why can I sense that ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper? Do you ... have any questions about the plan?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No, it's nothing. You make the call.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There will be many unexpected dangers in the labyrinth. We need to move carefully.
TO BE CONTINUED…
